prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a parking lot collision in Pasadena, Texas, and has whiplash. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1378; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather not give my full name on a recording, if that's okay. You can just refer to me as the claimant.

Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where you were when the collision happened?

A: I was in a parking lot at a grocery store in Pasadena, Texas. I had just pulled into a spot near the front entrance.

Q: What were you doing at the moment of impact?

A: I was backing out of the space, going slowly, maybe five miles an hour. I checked my mirror and didn't see anything, and then I heard this bang and felt the car jerk.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?

A: No. It came from the lane behind me, and I didn't see it until it was already hitting my rear bumper.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?

A: Yes, I was.

Q: Did you feel any injury right after the collision?

A: Not right away. I was a little shaken, but I got out and talked to the other driver. Later that evening my neck got stiff, and by the next morning I had pain running into my shoulders and headaches.

Q: Have you sought medical treatment since the accident?

A: Yes, I went to a clinic the following day. They diagnosed me with whiplash and told me to do physical therapy and rest for a few weeks.

Q: Are you still experiencing symptoms today?

A: Yes, I still have neck stiffness, and turning my head to the left hurts. Sitting for long periods makes it worse.

Q: Thank you. Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: Only that I want my vehicle repaired and my medical bills taken care of. I'm willing to cooperate however you need.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
